name: OSM Overpass Transit
description: Transit stop locations from OpenStreetMap as fallback

overpass.purpose: Fallback transit stop discovery using OpenStreetMap when no other provider covers the area
overpass.dataReceived: OSM nodes with name, ref, transport mode tags (train, tram, bus, subway, ferry, etc.)

overpass-kumi.purpose: Rate-limit fallback Overpass mirror (Kumi Systems e.U., Austria), used only when the primary Overpass endpoint is rate-limited or unavailable
overpass-kumi.dataSent: The Overpass QL query containing the map-viewport bounding box, sent server-side only when the primary endpoint is unavailable
overpass-kumi.dataReceived: OSM nodes with name, ref, transport mode tags (train, tram, bus, subway, ferry, etc.)
